nom: VANICREAM Moisturizing Lotion with Pump for Sensitive Skin

avis.texte: A number of years ago I suddenly broke out in a facial rash that was very inflamed. It turns out that the product I'd been using changed their formula. So a friend suggested trying vanicream lotion. I've been using it daily for 8 years and never a problem or rash. My skin looks great. I almost 80 and no one believes me because I have no wrinkles and no deep creases and my face looks healthy. It's the only thing I use. No cleansers or other products, just Vanicream moisturizing lotion daily. Now I do use a hot wash cloth just before applying to open the pores.

avis.titre: The most important ingredient really is trust
avis.texte: I trust Vanicream to provide all of my personal care products. They are the only company I have found that actually formulates products for allergic/reactive/sensitive skin types like mine and my daughters. We've tried "toxin free"/ "natural, organic" brands only to be left with raw, bumpy, itchy, inflamed skin and scalps. The Vanicream shampoo and conditioner clean our scalps and provides softness and shine all without the fragrance, itch, flakes and back acne. The gel gives my waves definition and keeps the frizz at bay. The face wash and body wash clean without leaving us dry or red. Also, there is no residue or smell, not even a lingering chemical one. We just smell like nothing which is what clean should smell like. Only recently did we switch from a popular brand of moisturizer with ceramides to Vanicream moisturizing lotion. Turns out the popular brand was giving us zits and blackheads and somehow also making us feel dry? Not vanicreams lotion. Our skin feels hydrated and more importantly we don't notice our skin which says it all. I also don't feel like I need "anti-aging" products anymore. I did try the vanicream face moisturizer but something in it broke me out (glyceryl stearate maybe?) but the moisturizing lotion makes my face skin look amazing so I'm cool with that. We hope to try the deodorant next too! Thank you Vanicream for caring about the health of your customers. If you keep the formulas the same we will keep buying. You really have made our lives a little

I've been experiencing some breakouts on my chin for a while now and didn't know why. Everyday I was wearing this lotion plus occasionally adding in some Lumi Glotion. Once I stopped using both, my skin magically stopped breaking out!
I thought it would be more moisturizing. It is a little sticky when drying

I like this lotion for the summer and when I am breaking out. It is light and gentle, but I like a thick moisturizer. Me and my mom like this lotion, it is SUPER good for all ages, because it is so gentle. It is kind of watery though. I have used this pretty much my whole life, and I love it.

avis.titre: Another Product Changed NOT for the Better
avis.texte: This product used to be a holy grail for me maybe 5 years ago, came back as my skin is flaring up and have to say, it fully sucks now. What did they change? It's slimy and won't absorb and then somehow skin is drier after using? I'm returning it. Another brand lost to the cash-grab-cheapening epidemic.
Bought this to use on my hands at bedtime. It makes my skin dry. Doesn't have any moisturizing effect. I'd wake up in the middle the night and my hands would be itchy from how dry they got.

I have rosacea and I heard great things about this product. I know everyone reacts to things differently and unfortunately my skin did not enjoy this lotion. It sinks into my skin , but I don't feel moisturized by it, or at least not to the extent Id like. I definitely didnt like using it on my face. I just felt dry after using it. I probably wont purchase again. It is unscented which is great!

I love this lotion. I have the strange combination of dry, sensitive skin that gets occasional pimples. This lotion doesn't irritate my skin or cause breakouts. Have tried the competitors and this is the best.

I have slightly dry, sensitive skin that can be prone to acne. It is often red and itchy after cleansing or wearing foundation. Most moisturizers (even fragrance free and non comedogenic) I'll get a few pimples. I finally found a cleanser that keeps my combination skin clear but is a little drying. More importantly I found that Vanicream lotion helps calm my skin and doesn't cause pimples. I am so happy with it and plan to try Vanicream cream for winter months when my skin is drier. Giving up on anti aging products has actually helped mybskin looked better.

bought this because everyone said it was super moisturizing and perfect for sensitive skin but ive been severly disappointed. i have their other daily moisturizer and i love it but this one is very underwhelming. it feels like paint when you put it on and takes forever to rub in, not to mention it feels so dry once its finally rubbed in and i feel like im even drier than before i tried this product.

avis.titre: BEST Moisturizer for sensitive, oily, acne prone skin.
avis.texte: I remember my freshman year in high school I tried and returned 10 different moisturizers. I had hard time finding a moisturizer my skin actually liked. Most were too heavy or not moisturizing enough and some contained fragrance or too many ingredients. This moisturizer has changed my life and my skin for the better. I still try other moisturizers but this one is better than all of them. I hope Vanicream never changes anything about this moisturizers.

My teenage daughter is on the spectrum and not only picks, but rubs her hands and wrists a lot. We've been able to reduce the picking and rubbing a lot with rubber bands to snap and fidget devices, but her hands and wrists were really in need of lotion or ointment.Unfortunately, she has some sensory issues and anything that leaves any kind of residue is so uncomfortable for her that it's like torture.Vanicream for Sensitive Skin was recommended to me in a Facebook group and I am so grateful! My daughter said she likes it and that she's going to use it every day. She is so happy to find something that soaks in fast and doesn't leave her skin feeling 'weird.'Additionally, my other daughter is very sensitive to smells and wasn't wanting to use anything... until we found this product.So, this is a win for the whole family!
Love this lotion. It's creamy and unscented and leaves my skin soft and feeling hydrated.
The only moisturizer i've found that doesn't burn my face when my moisture barrier is suffering. Lathers in well and absorbs nicely

avis.titre: Best lite lotion for rosacea. Perfect for day time and under
avis.texte: I love this lighter version of the thicker vanicream moisturizer. It's perfect for day time and under my makeup. The lite lotion and thick vanicream is all my rosacea skin can tolerate. Please don't stop making this. Thank you vanicream, love all your products.

Vanicream is truly one of my favorite moisturizers on the planet. I live for how much it leaves my skin feeling so soft in the morning. The deodorant smells a little funky but the ingredients in it helped my allergy so much. 11/10 recommend.

My sister told me about this lotion because I wanted a lotion with no toxic chemicals in it. Not greasy and my hands feel GREAT. This is my go to from now on. We need more products like this. Thanks for caring about your customers, Vanicream.

I have very sensitive skin and this moisturizer paired with the vanicream facial cleanser is THE BEST combination. My face actually feels clean and moisturized without being irritated at all. I will never stop using these products!!! also, a lot of moisturizers leave my face feeling weird like there's a film, but this one does not! it actually moisturizes.

I rarely take the time to write reviews but I had to make an exception! I know how important reviews are for me when looking into a product. I must say, I LOVE this lotion! It literally feels like silk on my skin, I use it on my face and my body. I love the texture, the way it makes my skin feel and look and it's so light weight, but effective! I like it has no fragrance so it is very gentle and doesn't interfere with whatever perfume I wear during the day (when I use it on my body which is almost daily). It's really worth every penny and so affordable. I've tried almost all of Sephoras skincare (quite literally) and this tops them all! I will never use another moisturizer, I just pray to the skin care Gods (lol) that they keep this product around for a long long time!! It's really the best, give it a go and you'll see for yourself and thank me later❣️

I received the vanicream spf cream from my dermatologist and enjoyed it so decided to purchase this body lotion. The lotion is a bit disappointing. Extremely lightweight, runny liquid consistency. It provides a tiny bit of moisture while applying but that nourishment dissipates almost immediately. My skin is normal dry. If you have sensitive skin that doesn't require much moisture you might enjoy this formula.

I absolutely love the Vanicream Lite. My dermatologist recommended this lotion to me with a sample when I was having TERRIBLE rashes, hives, and lip dermatitis and sores. Turned out to be Celiac Disease. I was SO miserable- everything stung and burned my skin. Steroids and gluten free diet eventually cleared up my skin- but I just lathered myself in this stuff. Even my lips! I will never give it up. Still use it daily!! Also, the sunscreen is awesome!

I love this lotion. My Dermatologist recommended it. I'd tried so many other products and none have worked as well to keep my skin soft throughout the day. Also love the Vanicream bar soap, face cleanser and shampoos.
Safe for my acne prone skin, not heavy which I love, perfect as my night time moisturizer. Awesome product if your night time routine has actives, very simple.
No allergic reaction at all. Totally safe. Also only occasionally will get a pimple as a result but for the most part nothing. Skin looks and feels great. My dad uses it and he looks so young too

Vanicream Lite is the only lotion I can use on my face. I am so thankful for it. I am very allergic to anything with a scent. I was wondering if you could make a lite version of your sunscreen since I seem to have a reaction to your regular sunscreen. My dermatologist wants me to wear sunscreen but I can't find one that I can wear. I am so glad for your company and that you continue to work to find solutions for those people who have major allergy problems.

I have always had oily skin. I've tried so many high end and drugstore moisturizers/lotions and every single one has either clogged my pores, broken me out, or caused irritation. This is the BEST product for oily skin.

I had really low expectations when I bought this, I had an allergy to something in another popular brand's product 'suited for sensitive skin' but I developed this weird sandpaper texture on my skin with severe dryness and flaking. I started a vanicream regimen exclusively and all the skin issues I wanted to correct just sort of vanished. No breakouts, no redness, no enlarged pores, no greasiness, no stinging. I'm hooked. It's smooth and easy to spread, and soaks right in. My sunscreen goes smoothly on top. I use this and the thicker cream at night. Can't praise it enough.
I have used Vanicream Lite in my face for the past 8-10 years. The only lotion I will use in my extremely oily skin. Love it.

avis.titre: Great facial lotion for the summer
avis.texte: I turned 30 and my skin started changing! I always had sensitive skin, but I could use organic products and not have an issue. Once my skin changed, I was searching and searching for a product that wouldn't break me out, burn my skin, or cause redness. I finally found Vanicream and the product has worked great!! At night i use the Vanicream Moisturizing Cream after cleansing with Vanicream Gentle Facial Cleanser. During the day I actually mix the Vanicream lite lotion with the Vanicream Moisturizing Cream. The Lite Lotion is a little bit too light for my dry skin, but I found during the summer months the cream was a little bit too heavy to wear during the day/while I was active. Once I mixed the cream with the lite lotion, I found the perfect balance for my face! I keep getting compliments on how nice my skin looks and how I even have this dewy look to my face. I even tried Cetaphil at one point and that made me break out/burn/redness. I even had a question about one of the ingredients within Vanicream and the sales rep immediately reached out and was so nice! Thanks for making a great product! Can you please make a facial scrub!!!!!! That would complete my skincare routine which would consist of all Vanicream products. ?
I've been looking for a non-thick, airy, and non-scent lotion for my sensitive skin for 4 years! Vanicream has been the best so far and I love it! It's also a great base for Make-up or sunscreen.

Over the years I have bought more moisturizers than I can mention – only to be told that I'll see results after six or seven uses. Vanicream works immediately. I'm older so I have creppy skin on my forearm – it actually takes that look away by plumping everything up. It's truly an amazing product – and, it's priced reasonably.

avis.titre: Not for very dry skin with eczena
avis.texte: I use the vanicream in a tub most days, I was looking for something a bit lighter for when I wasn't having eczena flare-ups. It is strange for me as it has a sticky texture and doesn't soak in very well at all. The cream in the tub is better for me

avis.titre: The Best Head to Toe Moisterizer
avis.texte: Keeps skin feeling dewy without irritation. Works wonderfully under make up without serums, under eye creams, etc. use morning and night..

The lite lotion is truly amazing! My skin has never felt so smooth in all my life. I use it every single day right after my shower and can use it on every inch of my body. Thank you so much and please don't ever stop making this awesome product!!!

avis.titre: BEST lotion I have ever used!
avis.texte: Hypothyroidism, menopause and the elements have taken a toll on my skin. This is the best lotion I have ever used. I feel soft and supple again instead of rough, dry and visibly ashy skin.

I am forever trying to find face lotions and washes that give me the best results. I have combination skin and have struggled to find a lotion that actually works. My dermatologist recommended this and gave me a few samples. I am beyond in love with this! I also use the cleanser from vanicream. My skin has never looked or felt better!

I have rosacea and I have to be careful what I use on my face. I use this lotion as a moisturizing base and then use the Vanicream SFP 50 sunscreen (a critical component of caring for skin with rosacea). No more breakouts or redness for me now that I'm using great products. Thank you, Vanicream, for making products that work.

This lite lotion is just right for my face. I have combination skin that is acne prone and very sensitive. I wash with the vanicream bar soap and follow with this lotion and that's it! Leaves skin soft and smooth with no irritation or acne. In fact I use this lotion and soap for face, hands and body. Best products I have ever used. I also use the shampoo and conditioner and love them. I plan on trying their other products, too. It is so hard to find products that are truly made for sensitive skin that work. I have tried so many brands. I remembered this brand from some time ago but it was so hard to find and back then we didn't have personal computers not to mention smart phones. So, I tried other products. But Vanicream, is the best!
I use the vanicream cleansing bar and lite lotion daily. My skin has never looked or felt better. These are no frill products that do a superior job as daily facial products.

After developing allergies to fragrance and a particular chemical my allergist recommended this. Effective, with a nice texture, I use it every day after showering. Body, hands, face, all around perfect. I like the cream too for heels, etc.
Like it! It's light feeling, not heavy. Moisturizes, yet has breathability.

avis.titre: Great for face to avoid clogged pores
avis.texte: I love the regular vanicream, but after a string of acne-like reactions due to clogged pores, my dermatologist recommended to switch to lite for the face. It's worked like a charm and I continue using vanicream on the rest of my body.

I use this mostly on my face, but also on my body. Coming from someone with sensitive combo skin, this product doesn't break out my skin, make it oily or cause any irritation. It's the perfect moisturizer for sensitive skin.

I have used the lotions and creams for 10 years. This product was recommended to my by my dermatologist and I have loved these products ever since. I have eczema mainly on my hands so I keep the smaller tubes in my purse for when I'm out and about. I would highly recommend these products.
I absolutely love this product and I have been trying eczema products for 50 years. This is a miracle. Thank you

Love this product! Have used it, and most of the other products as well, for over five years. Do wish it was available in a large bottle to refill other pump bottles though. I have found the cleanser in large bottles.

I suffer from psoriasis, so have to be careful with what I use as my skin is easily irritated .. my sister, who lives in the US, introduced me to Vanicream Lite Lotion several years ago, and I have found it fabulous .. it moisturizes my skin really well without leaving a sticky residue, and it effectively keeps my skin subtle and comfortable for hours .. Thank you for such a cost effective and simple way to manage my skins needs ..
Excellent product! I use this as my face moisturizer. Also on the body, but my daily face moisturizer. My skin is gorgeous and clear and no longer itchy throughout the day.

I have finally found something I can use all over my body, I could never use anything on my face . I would use products on body and if they got to close to my face it would break out and get all red and puffy.This is an awesome product. Please don't ever change ingredients . I have tried all kinds of products from the top of the shelves to the bottom of the shelves and even organic and natural. Stuff would work for a while and then i would start breaking out . Some products were just to heavy for my skin . The products that have lanolin in them once i applied them i could almost taste them it was horrible . I use all your products – soap -shampoo-conditioner-gel-hairspray- lip sunscreen – ointment-I have not tried the cleanser yet but plan on it .I tell everyone that I know about your products especially the ones with problems . :):)
I have never rated a product before but vanicream deserves it! Absolutely no fragrance, goes on well and won't clog Pores! Simply the best!

I needed a face cream that created a moisture to my face without drying it out. I was given this as a sample at my doctor's due to my eczema on my face. It has been just great. I will continue to use this product.

I don't know what I would do without This lotion. I first heard about it through my dermatologist. She said that with my sensitive skin I would need to use something like this. THIS STUFF IS THE BOMB! Perfect for a dry and sensitive face. Vanicream is awesome!

I have extremely sensitive skin, and anything I put on my skin burns and turns red and puffy. I had tried a bunch of the dermatologist recommended products ( cera ve, cetaphil, aveno, etc) but they still all burned. I finally re called my dermatologist and asked if there was anything else I could use for my skin, and they suggested vani cream. This product really helped the redness in my skin, and hydrated all of the dry patches. I would TOTALLY recommend this stuff!! It is amazing!! It doesn't burn, or leave a greasy residue!

avis.titre: Great Face Moisturizer for Sensitive Skin!
avis.texte: I've always had that weird combination skin – oily, with dry eczema spots. I tried Vanicream Lite Lotion a few years ago and it is hands-down the best face moisturizer I've used. It moisturizes without being too heavy or greasy, and it works as a great base before applying foundation/make-up. I use it every single morning and recommend it to anyone with sensitive skin.

I normally don't rate products, but Vanicream has been unlike anything else. For months on months I'd been looking for a face moisturizer that would get my dry skin under control. However, my skin is highly sensitive and at the time was so raw that everything I tried burned. Just when I thought of giving up on it, I found Vanicream and it gave results within days!! It's the only thing that doesn't burn me and I can honestly say I love it! If you're looking for a cure to dry skin, Vanicream is the way to go ?
I always look for lotion with no smell and non-greasy and this one is perfect. I started using it after my daughter recommended it to me, she loves your products!

I love this lotion.My only suggestion is I have rosacea and your cleansers are oil free which I love.The only product your company doesn't make is a oil free moisturizer.If you ever do you will have the market in skin care.Just a suggestion but I know oil free Vanicream moisturizer would be a big success!!! Thanks Vanicream!!!

Love this lotion for everyday use. It is nice and light and absorbs quickly. I use this on my face and body and this is the only line of products I can use that doesn't burn and sting my skin. Best stuff ever!

I use this product every day. I use it on my body and my face. If I try and use any other products on my face, within a few days, my face will start to break out. It doesn't break out bad at first, but if i don't switch back it starts to get bad.
I use this lotion daily on my face, it even got rid of the dry skin bumps on my forehead.
